blast_radius: No writes beyond its own reports; the risk is silent loss of regression coverage.

throughput.derivation: Executed runs = ledger rows with a dated report_path and aborted=false. Abort rows carry no timestamp at all, so they cannot be windowed and are counted only in aggregate.

floor.reason: insufficient history: only 2 covered days carry a dated report_path; the remaining rows are undated aborts

notes: Several dozen abort records exist in the feature-health ledger, all abort_reason='load-guard' (illustrative count).
Abort records have no timestamp field — a schema gap that makes the abort rate itself unwindowable.

verification.note: Graded on throughput, not liveness: a running loop with zero volume is DEGRADED.

what_it_does: feature-health tier1/tier2/tier3 suites (com.omniagentos.feature-health-tier1 every 4h and .feature-health-nightly at 03:10). Volume is feature runs that actually executed, i.e. ledger rows with a report_path and aborted=false.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates a real running-but-idle failure: a loaded, firing process can still produce zero executed runs when every invocation aborts under a load guard. Liveness says green while throughput says nothing has actually been checked.
